title: Interactive Origami Tutorials | Origami Penguin
heading: Interactive Origami Tutorials
description: Learn ten origami models step by step. Drag the paper in your browser or follow along with a real square.
body:
Pick any of the ten models below. Drag the green point into the outlined target to see how the fold works. You can also follow along with a real square of paper.

Choose a model

Try this fold with real paper

Browse illustrated tutorials
styles: #fold-quest [hidden]{display:none}#fold-paper{margin:1rem 0;background:white;border:2px solid #9cb8b3;border-radius:12px;padding:.75rem;text-align:center}#fold-image{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;max-height:420px;margin:auto;object-fit:contain}#fold-surface{display:block;width:min(100%,400px);height:auto;margin:auto;background:#f0f7f5;border-radius:10px;touch-action:none;cursor:grab}#fold-surface:active{cursor:grabbing}#fold-surface:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #903b65;outline-offset:3px}#fold-quest button{font:inherit;min-height:44px;padding:.65rem .85rem;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #52736b;background:white;color:#18394a;cursor:pointer}#fold-quest button:hover:not(:disabled),#fold-continue{background:#d9eee3}#fold-quest button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #903b65;outline-offset:3px}#fold-status{min-height:2em}#fold-models,.fold-controls{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.55rem}#fold-models button{flex:1 0 min(8rem,100%)}#fold-models small{display:block}#fold-models button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#d9eee3;border-color:#246458;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #246458}#fold-quest button:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:default}#fold-goal{scroll-margin-top:1rem}#fold-progress{font-weight:700}#fold-caption{font-weight:600}#fold-models svg{display:block;width:100%;max-width:104px;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1;margin:0 auto .2rem;background:#f0f7f5;border-radius:8px}#fold-models strong{display:block}#fold-models small{margin-top:.25rem}.fold-difficulty{display:inline-block;margin-top:.2rem;padding:.1rem .55rem;border-radius:1rem;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700}.fold-difficulty.easy{background:#dcefe0;color:#21563b}.fold-difficulty.medium{background:#faebc8;color:#62420c}.fold-difficulty.hard{background:#f3e2ee;color:#6e285a}
